_new_items.feature: Composer focus vs selection chord priority ladder
_new_items.behavior: A single ⌘/Ctrl+L is contested by 'Focus composer' and 'Send selection to composer'; the ladder in composer-focus-keys.ts decides per press which one claims it (selection wins when text is selected).
Buttons can render their live keybinding as a hint chip (use-keybind-hint), so a control shows the same chord the shortcuts panel lists and hides it when the action is unbound.
Theme/accent picker offers 'Accent color', 'Theme default', preset swatches and a 'Custom color' entry that overrides the theme accent; the choice persists per install.

_new_items.feature: Notification recovery actions (Open Keys/Gateways/Maintenance, Restart Hermes)
_new_items.behavior: Recognised errors carry a recovery action on the toast — 'Restart Hermes', 'Open Keys', 'Open Gateways', 'Open Maintenance' — so the user can act from the notification instead of hunting in settings.

_new_items.feature: Version-skew notices (backend/desktop out of date, update ready)
_new_items.behavior: When the app and backend versions diverge the app raises 'Backend out of date' ('Your Hermes backend is older than this desktop build and may not work correctly. Update to align them.') or 'Hermes app out of date', with actions 'Update app' / 'Update Hermes'; when changes are available it shows 'Update ready' ('<n> new changes available.') with "See what's new".

A background update check raises a notification titled 'Update ready' ('<n> new changes available.' or 'A new update is available.') with "See what's new" and, for AppInstaller installs, 'Update now and Windows will finish it for you.'
The titlebar has a haptics toggle reading 'Mute haptics' when on and 'Unmute haptics' when muted; on hardware without haptics the control is a no-op/hidden.
With HUD mode up, a titlebar action 'Reset HUD size and position' restores the HUD's default size and placement — the recovery path after moving or resizing it.
The sessions-sidebar titlebar button shows an unread badge and its tooltip appends ' · <n> unread session(s)', so background activity is visible without opening the sidebar.
Pages and plugins can contribute controls into the titlebar's left/right slots; when a page contributes any, the fixed app-action cluster steps aside so the page owns the strip.

The status bar carries an 'Approvals' pill showing the current mode (Manual / Smart / Off) that toggles it, and warns 'YOLO on — auto-approving dangerous commands. Shift+click toggles globally.' / 'YOLO off. Shift+click toggles globally.'
